title: NIST updated its page: Additional signatures – Round 3 candidates
summary: The SQIsign entry now includes links to an IP Statement, Specifications, and a Zip file download. Several new submitters were added to the SQIsign team: Giacomo Borin, Thomas Espitau, Riccardo Invernizzi, Marzio Mula, Frederik Vercauteren, Alexandre Wallet, and Wessel van Woerden.
why_it_matters: The addition of specification documents and an IP statement for SQIsign makes it easier for the public and researchers to review and evaluate the algorithm. Expanding the submitter team may reflect ongoing development and broader collaboration on this isogeny-based signature scheme.

title: Transition to PQC Standards | NIST IR 8547
summary: NIST released a report called NIST IR 8547 on October 27, 2026, laying out its official road map for switching from today's encryption methods — which a future quantum computer could break — to the new quantum-resistant standards the agency finalized in August 2024. The report tells federal agencies, businesses, and standards bodies what needs to change and by when.
why_it_matters: This road map gives organizations a concrete timeline to follow, making it easier to plan and prioritize the switch to quantum-safe encryption before powerful quantum computers potentially arrive and render current security obsolete.
